encyclopedia.summary: Jan de Bont's 1994 action film starts from one rule: a bomb on a bus arms itself the moment the speed drops below fifty miles an hour. A cop who was negotiating with the bomber ends up aboard, riding the city with the passengers. Holding two hours on a single space and a single condition made it a textbook for 1990s action.
highlights: Moves the arena from bus to subway to freeway and varies the same rule three times.
The hero is not a clean professional but a man whose own mistake raised the stakes.
One condition, speed, decides the editing and sound rhythm.

related.note: 1980s action built on one man trapped in one space
A later generation reworking the grammar around close combat
